DLC2308:3:t_2:79.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Don't be modest. Your discerning palate and style of criticism have been talked about many times, Managing Director.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:82.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Attention, all personnel. A $$新地球皇国$$ force has been confirmed thirty kilometers south of our position.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:84.en:
$$エマ$$
「Where the local resistance forces have a supply base.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:85.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「So the Empire is targeting the resistance's lifeline.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:86.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We can't overlook this. ...Captain $$オットー$$...!」

DLC2308:3:t_2:87.en:
$$オットー$$
「Understood. We're moving to intercept!」

DLC2308:3:t_3:3.en:
$$厚井$$
「...Welcome back, $$ロジャー$$. About that cooking contest you mentioned...」

DLC2308:3:t_3:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That was a joke. Please forget about it, Managing Director.」

DLC2308:3:t_3:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Besides, after seeing something like that, I can only say that ranking food is nonsense.」

DLC2308:3:t_3:6.en:
$$郁絵$$
「Welcome back, $$刹那$$. Good work out there.」

DLC2308:3:t_3:7.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$郁絵$$... And $$フェルト$$ too...」

DLC2308:3:t_3:8.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Here, an apple. $$郁絵$$ taught me how to cut it into rabbits.」

DLC2308:3:t_3:10.en:
$$郁絵$$
「Was that a little too childish?」

DLC2308:3:t_3:11.en:
$$フェルト$$
「But... these also remind me of the $$ロックオン$$ we lost.」

DLC2308:3:t_3:14.en:
$$刹那$$
（I'm sure this is what it means to understand one another...）

DLC2308:3:t_3:15.en:
$$厚井$$
「Yes, yes... Something made for someone else... That is real cooking.」

DLC2308:3:t_3:17.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「$$ロジャー$$, $$厚井$$. Would you like some coffee?」

DLC2308:3:t_3:18.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「There's also tea brewed by Captain $$オットー$$ himself.」

DLC2308:3:t_3:19.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Since you've gone to the trouble, I'll have both coffee and tea.」

DLC2308:3:t_3:20.en:
$$厚井$$
「The harsh fighting begins tomorrow... This will probably be our last chance to rest.」

DLC2308:3:t_3:21.en:
$$ロジャー$$
（Rather than fear an enemy we've yet to see, we chose to move forward knowing the danger...）

DLC2308:3:t_3:22.en:
$$ロジャー$$
（Luck won't decide how this gamble ends. We'll seize our destiny with our own hands...）

DLC2308:3:t_3:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Those who don't work don't eat... Never underestimate a grudge over food...」

DLC2308:3:t_3:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There are all kinds of proverbs and sayings about food. I'm sure you've heard some of them in your daily lives.」

DLC2308:3:t_3:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hm... You want to know what my favorite food is?」

DLC2308:3:t_3:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm a robot, so I don't eat. Though I'm often told I have a taste for making fools of people...」

DLC2308:4:t_000:0.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Damn it! They've caught up with us completely!」

DLC2308:4:t_000:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Tch... I, a renowned master strategist, removed from defending the imperial capital and sent to exterminate rats...」

DLC2308:4:t_000:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I'll take this frustration... out on that one!」

DLC2308:4:t_001:0.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「If I don't get this food to the base, everyone will...!」

DLC2308:4:t_001:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Hahaha! Run, run! Resist with all your might and keep me entertai...」

DLC2308:4:t_003:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「It appears $$ギルター・ベローネ$$ is commanding the enemy force.」

DLC2308:4:t_003:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That bastard...! Was he tormenting the resistance transport!?」

DLC2308:4:t_003:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「As nasty as ever! We can't let this slide!」

DLC2308:4:t_003:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Morale is high, considering we had to leave the party halfway through.」

DLC2308:4:t_003:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「We got to relax with some delicious food, after all.」

DLC2308:4:t_003:6.en:
$n
「Let's finish them off quickly and get back to the party.」

DLC2308:4:t_003:7.en:
$$オットー$$
「This is Colonel $$オットー・ミタス$$ of $c, an independent unit of the $$地球連邦軍$$. Leave this to us and fall back.」

DLC2308:4:t_003:8.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Thank you for the rescue! Now we can deliver the food!」

DLC2308:4:t_004:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「...No matter. Crushing them here will improve my standing even more.」

DLC2308:4:t_004:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$ギルター・ベローネ$$... Did you attack that transport knowing it was carrying food?」

DLC2308:4:t_004:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Of course. Striking supply lines is the most basic principle of strategy.」

DLC2308:4:t_004:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Hunger is a more effective weapon than missiles. No matter what kind of warrior you are, you'll bow to it in the end.」

DLC2308:4:t_004:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Your argument is sound, $$ギルター$$.」

DLC2308:4:t_004:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「But! Your luck ran out when you showed us that kind of tactic today!」

DLC2308:4:t_005:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I never liked you, but today, I absolutely can't stand you!」

DLC2308:4:t_005:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Everyone! Let's beat him to a pulp!」

DLC2308:4:t_005:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ギルター・ベローネ$$... Let us teach you a fundamental truth of living beings.」

DLC2308:4:t_005:7.en:
$$レド$$
「$$ギルター$$! Learn what it means to hold a grudge over food!!」

DLC2308:4:t_006:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Never underestimate a grudge over food... That says it all.」

DLC2308:4:t_006:2.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Incoming message from $c's main force. The party is still going.」

DLC2308:4:t_006:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「Good. Order all units to return. If we head back now, we should make it in time for dessert.」

DLC2308:4:t_007:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Th-this is bad! First I lost $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$, and now I've failed here too...!」

DLC2308:4:t_007:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「At this rate, I'll be transferred to some dead-end post!」

DLC2308:4:t_007:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「And it's all your fault! Your very existence is, to me...」

DLC2308:4:t_007:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Wh-what!? What are you trying to say!?」

DLC2308:4:t_007:6.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You bastaaards! You, of all people...」

DLC2308:4:t_007:7.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Didn't you hear me? Get lost. Now.」

DLC2308:4:t_008:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「At that point, he's gone beyond disgraceful. He's almost pitiful.」

DLC2308:4:t_008:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「With this many failures in a row, we probably won't see him again.」

DLC2308:4:t_100:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「We're moving forward! Shoot down every last one!」

review.context: An enemy alert interrupts the feast. The returning team sees Feldt's rabbit-shaped apple slices as genuine care through food. Combat events show Giltar attacking a food transport and the partygoers furious at his use of hunger as a weapon.
decisions: Dorothy is Roger's android companion, using the Big O-specific token.
The remembered deceased Lockon is Neil, not his surviving brother; the line preserves the shared name token.
AG's 'eating people' idiom is rendered through having a taste for making fools of people, retaining impudence and a food image.
Giltar's interrupted entertainment boast stays interrupted.
Earth Federation Forces uses the Universal Century token in Otto's formal identification.
